      "asserted_values": [],

    {
      "id": "4",
      "type": "IO",
      "text": "The function returns the computed checksum as a 64-bit value.",
      "asserted_values": [],
      "confidence": 1.0
    }
  ],
  "recovered_c": "uint64_t fn_03(const uint8_t *in, size_t len, uint64_t arg, uint8_t *out, size_t out_cap) {\n  uint32_t a = 1;\n  uint32_t b = 0;\n  for (size_t i = 0; i < len; i++) {\n    a = (in[i] + a) % 0xfff1;\n    b = (b + a) % 0xfff1;\n  }\n  return (uint64_t)a | ((uint64_t)b << 0x10);\n}"
}
